en: Color postcard showing an aerial view of Tulcea on the Danube River: the waterfront with passenger boats, the modernist Hotel Delta, communist-era apartment blocks around a central square, streets and greenery along the quay. The reverse has Romanian text, a blue 1 leu Poșta Română stamp (Curtea de Argeș), a Tulcea postmark dated 1981, and is addressed to a county committee in Craiova.
